title: Boarding or alighting from vehicle (2)
text: A person shall not open the door of or board or alight from the side of a vehicle which is closest to passing traffic in such a manner as to interfere with moving vehicular traffic.
subject: occupant

title: Boarding or alighting from vehicle (3)
text: A person shall not leave open a door on the side of a vehicle which is closest to passing traffic longer than is necessary for immediate loading or unloading of passengers or cargo.
subject: occupant

title: One-way highway (2)
text: A vehicle passing around a rotary traffic island shall be driven only to the right of such island.
subject: driver

title: Overtaking and passing school bus (1)
text: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 2, the driver of any vehicle, when meeting or overtaking, from either direction, any school bus, equipped with signs and signals required by law, which has stopped to receive or discharge any pupil and is displaying a flashing red light signal visible from the front and rear, shall bring the vehicle to an immediate stop and shall not attempt to overtake or proceed past the school bus until the flashing red signal ceases operation. The driver of a vehicle upon a divided highway need not stop upon meeting or passing a school bus which is positioned in the other roadway. The driver of a vehicle need not stop upon meeting or passing a school bus where traffic is controlled by a traffic officer.
subject: driver

title: Maximum speed of school bus (1)
text: A school bus shall not exceed: A speed of 55 miles per hour when transporting pupils to and from school.
subject: school_bus_driver

title: Stopping, standing or parking prohibited in specified places (1)(m)
text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Upon any bridge or other elevated structure or within a highway tunnel.
subject: driver

title: Unattended motor vehicle
text: A vehicle shall not be permitted to stand unattended upon any perceptible grade without stopping the engine and effectively setting the brake thereon and turning the front wheels to the curb or side of the highway.
subject: driver

title: Circumstances in which driver or operator of slow-moving vehicle has duty to turn off roadway (1)
text: On a highway that has one lane for traveling in each direction, where passing is unsafe because of traffic traveling in the opposite direction or other conditions, the driver or operator of a slow-moving vehicle, behind which five or more vehicles are formed in a line, shall, to allow the vehicles following behind to proceed, turn off the roadway: (a) At the nearest place designated as a turnout by signs erected by the public authority having jurisdiction over the highway; or (b) In the absence of such a designated turnout, at the nearest place where: (1) Sufficient area for a safe turnout exists; and (2) The circumstances and conditions are such that the driver or operator is able to turn off the roadway in a safe manner. As used in this section, “slow-moving vehicle” means a vehicle that is traveling at a rate of speed which is less than the posted speed limit for the highway or portion of the highway upon which the vehicle is traveling.
subject: driver

title: Special limitations on speed (2)
text: It is unlawful for any person to drive a vehicle over any bridge or other elevated structure constituting a part of a highway at a speed which is greater than the maximum speed which can be maintained with safety to the bridge or structure, when such structure is signposted as provided in this section [(3) appended below]. The Department of Transportation upon request from any local authority shall, or upon its own initiative may, conduct an investigation of any bridge or other elevated structure constituting a part of a highway constructed and maintained under the authority granted by chapter 408 of NRS, and if it thereupon finds that such structure cannot with safety to itself withstand vehicles traveling at the speed otherwise permissible under chapters 484A to 484E, inclusive, of NRS, the Department shall determine and declare the maximum speed of vehicles which such structure can safely withstand, and shall cause or permit suitable signs stating such maximum speed to be erected and maintained at a distance of 100 feet before each end of such structure.
subject: driver

title: “Low-speed vehicle” defined (2)(b)
text: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 3 [(3) and (4) appended below]: A person shall not operate a low-speed vehicle upon a highway where the posted speed limit is greater than 35 miles per hour, except to cross such a highway at an intersection. If registered, a neighborhood occupantless vehicle may operate on a highway where the posted speed limit is greater than 35 miles per hour but not more than 45 miles per hour. As used in this section, “neighborhood occupantless vehicle” means a low-speed vehicle that is not designed, intended or marketed for human occupancy.
subject: low_speed_vehicle_operator

title: Personal delivery device (2)(a)
text: A personal delivery device operator may not allow a personal delivery device to: Operate on the highways of this State except when crossing at an intersection or within a crosswalk.
subject: delivery_device_operator

title: Personal delivery device (2)(b)
text: A personal delivery device operator may not allow a personal delivery device to: Fail to comply with any traffic-control signal or devices that a pedestrian is obligated to comply with.
subject: delivery_device_operator

title: Personal delivery device (2)(c)
text: A personal delivery device operator may not allow a personal delivery device to: Unreasonably interfere with pedestrians or vehicle traffic.
subject: delivery_device_operator

title: Mobile carrying device (2)(a)
text: The operator of a mobile carrying device may not allow a mobile carrying device to: Operate on the highways of this State except when crossing within a crosswalk.
subject: delivery_device_operator

title: Mobile carrying device (2)(b)
text: The operator of a mobile carrying device may not allow a mobile carrying device to: Fail to comply with any traffic-control signal or devices that a pedestrian is obligated to comply with.
subject: delivery_device_operator

title: Mobile carrying device (2)(c)
text: The operator of a mobile carrying device may not allow a mobile carrying device to: Unreasonably interfere with pedestrians or vehicle traffic.
subject: delivery_device_operator

title: Additional equipment for lighting (4)
text: Any motor vehicle may be equipped with one or more backup lamps either separately or in combination with other lamps. Backup lamps shall not be lighted when the vehicle is in forward motion.
subject: driver

title: Conditions for use of compression brakes (1)
text: The driver of a vehicle which is equipped with a device for braking that uses the compression of the engine of the vehicle shall not use the device at any time unless: (a) The device is equipped with an operational muffler; or (b) The driver reasonably believes that an emergency requires the use of the device to protect the physical safety of a person or others from an immediate threat of physical injury or to protect against an immediate threat of damage to property.
subject: driver

title: Two-way left-turn lanes (C)
text: A vehicle shall not be driven in a designated two-way left-turn lane except when preparing for or making a left turn. A left turn shall not be made from any other lane where a two-way left-turn lane has been designated.
subject: driver

title: Wheeled toys on streets and sidewalks (A)
text: It shall be unlawful for any person to ride or use a coaster, roller skates, scooter, skateboard, toy vehicle or similar device: On any roadway except while crossing a street at a crosswalk, and, when any such device is so crossing, it shall be granted all of the rights and shall be subject to all of the duties applicable to pedestrians.
subject: rider

title: Wheeled toys on streets and sidewalks (B)
text: It shall be unlawful for any person to ride or use a coaster, roller skates, scooter, skateboard, toy vehicle or similar device: On the sidewalks of Fremont Street between Main Street and Seventh Street which, because of the high volume of pedestrian traffic normally present, shall be posted with signs indicating that the use of these devices on the sidewalk is prohibited.
subject: rider

title: Wheeled toys on streets and sidewalks (C)
text: It shall be unlawful for any person to ride or use a coaster, roller skates, scooter, skateboard, toy vehicle or similar device: On any other public property when signs have been erected at the entrances to, or displayed prominently on, the property prohibiting the use of coasters, roller skates, scooters, skateboards, toy vehicles or similar devices on such property.
subject: rider

title: Operation of vehicle within one hundred feet of an ice cream truck (A)
text: Within one hundred feet of an ice cream truck that has engaged the safety equipment described in Subsection (C) of Section 6.47.100 [DEF-LVMC-6-47-100-C], it is unlawful to operate a vehicle as follows: At a speed greater than is prudent when children are present in the area.
subject: driver

title: Operation of vehicle within one hundred feet of an ice cream truck (B)
text: Within one hundred feet of an ice cream truck that has engaged the safety equipment described in Subsection (C) of Section 6.47.100 [DEF-LVMC-6-47-100-C], it is unlawful to operate a vehicle as follows: In excess of fifteen miles per hour, in any event.
subject: driver

title: Reversible lanes—Temporary designation
text: The City Traffic Engineer is authorized to determine and designate streets, or specific lanes thereon upon which vehicular traffic shall proceed in one direction during one period and the opposite direction during another period of the day, and may also erect signs temporarily designating lanes to be used by traffic moving in any particular direction, regardless of the centerline of the roadway. It shall be unlawful for any person to operate any vehicle in violation of such markings, signs, barriers, or other devices so placed in accordance with this Section.
subject: driver

title: Operation of vehicles within a roundabout (A)
text: The following regulations pertain to the operation of vehicles within a roundabout: All vehicular travel shall be in a counterclockwise direction.
subject: driver

title: Operation of vehicles within a roundabout (B)
text: The following regulations pertain to the operation of vehicles within a roundabout: The operator of a vehicle entering a roundabout shall yield the right-of-way to vehicles already in the roundabout and wait for a gap in traffic before entering.
subject: driver

title: Operation of vehicles within a roundabout (C)(1)
text: The following regulations pertain to the operation of vehicles within a roundabout: The operator of a vehicle who intends to exit a roundabout: Shall use the left lane to turn left or complete a U-turn.
subject: driver

title: Operation of vehicles within a roundabout (C)(2)
text: The following regulations pertain to the operation of vehicles within a roundabout: The operator of a vehicle who intends to exit a roundabout: Shall use the right lane to turn right.
subject: driver
